stories.title: Kans groot dat race in Bakoe laatste mogelijkheid op zege was voor Verstappen

en.title: Chances high that Bakoe race was Verstappen's last opportunity to win
en.summary: Max Verstappen finished 0.196 seconds behind George Russell in Bakoe. With Mercedes bringing a major upgrade package to Malaysia next week, analysts believe this may have been Verstappen's best remaining chance for a victory this season.

stories.title: Meerdere gewonden door steekvlam bij buurtbarbecue in Gronings dorp De Wilp

en.title: Multiple injured by flash fire at neighborhood barbecue in Groningen village De Wilp
en.summary: A flash fire at a neighborhood barbecue in De Wilp, Groningen injured multiple people on Saturday evening. Eight people sustained burns, with two requiring hospitalization.

stories.title: Merwedebrug na werkzaamheden eerder open, verbod vrachtwagens blijft gelden

en.title: Merwedebrug reopens after maintenance, truck ban remains in effect
en.summary: The Merwedebrug near Gorinchem reopened to traffic overnight between Saturday and Sunday after maintenance work finished ahead of schedule. The bridge was expected to remain closed until Monday morning.

stories.title: Merwedebrug weer open na werkzaamheden, sneller dan verwacht

en.title: Merwedebrug reopens after maintenance, faster than expected
en.summary: The Merwedebrug on the A27 near Gorinchem reopened after maintenance work completed faster than planned. The bridge received a thinner asphalt layer, reducing its weight by approximately 400 tons to ensure safe operation.

stories.title: Meerdere gewonden door steekvlam op buurtfeest in De Wilp

en.title: Multiple injured by flash fire at neighborhood gathering in De Wilp
en.summary: Several people suffered burns at a neighborhood event in the Dutch village of De Wilp after someone threw flammable liquid onto a fire pit, causing a sudden flame. Eight people were injured, with two requiring hospital treatment.

stories.title: Nederlandse wielrenster Demi Vollering sprint naar eerste wereldtitel: ‘Ik moest er tot in mijn kleine teen aan toe in blijven geloven’

en.title: Dutch cyclist Demi Vollering sprints to first world title: 'I had to keep believing all the way'
en.summary: Dutch cyclist Demi Vollering won her first world championship title in road cycling at the world championships.

stories.title: Wereldtitel wielrennen voor Demi Vollering, na zinderende finale

en.title: World cycling title for Demi Vollering after thrilling finale
en.summary: Demi Vollering secured her first world championship gold medal at the road cycling world championships in Canada with a dominant performance.

stories.title: Demi Vollering voor het eerst wereldkampioene na zenuwslopende wegrit

en.title: Demi Vollering becomes world champion for the first time after nerve-wracking road race
en.summary: The 29-year-old Dutch cyclist Demi Vollering won her first world championship title in Montreal, outsprinting competitor Kasia Niewiadoma in a closely contested race.

stories.title: Wat staat Manchester City te wachten nu het schuldig is bevonden aan ‘financiële doping’? 'De tijdbom die boven het Europese voetbal tikte, is eindelijk ontploft'

en.title: What awaits Manchester City now it has been found guilty of 'financial doping'? 'The time bomb ticking above European football has finally exploded'
en.summary: Manchester City was found guilty of 114 out of 115 charges related to breaching financial regulations, marking a major moment in international football governance.

stories.title: Amerikaanse ambassadeur reageert fel op Jetten: 'ICC moet handen afhouden van VS'

en.title: American ambassador reacts sharply to Jetten: 'ICC must keep hands off US'
en.summary: Dutch Prime Minister Rob Jetten called for the International Criminal Court to stay out of US affairs during UN proceedings. The US ambassador to the Netherlands responded that America would reciprocate such restraint.

stories.title: Kabinet beweegt op bezuinigingen sociale zekerheid, zoekt steun box 3 op rechts

en.title: Cabinet moves on social security cuts, seeks support for box 3 on the right
en.summary: The Dutch cabinet is adjusting its approach to social security spending cuts while seeking political support from right-wing parties regarding box 3 taxation policy.

stories.title: Russell blijft Verstappen in Bakoe net voor en mag weer beetje hopen op de titel

en.title: Russell stays just ahead of Verstappen in Baku and can hope for the title again
en.summary: George Russell narrowly finished ahead of Max Verstappen in the Baku race, keeping his championship hopes alive.
